recommendation_template.title: Enforce multi-factor authentication
recommendation_template.body: Sensitive data is present but MFA is not enforced. Require MFA for all users with access to sensitive systems before any AI initiative ingests that data.

recommendation_template.title: Assign an accountable AI governance owner
recommendation_template.body: No accountable owner exists for AI governance. Designate a named owner responsible for AI risk, policy, and oversight.

recommendation_template.title: Improve data quality before model adoption
recommendation_template.body: Reported data quality score is {data_quality_score}/5, below the threshold for reliable AI outcomes. Establish data quality SLAs and remediation before adoption.

recommendation_template.title: Complete a Data Protection Impact Assessment
recommendation_template.body: Sensitive/personal data is in scope but no DPIA has been completed. A DPIA is required before processing this data in an AI system.

recommendation_template.title: Plan for model monitoring and observability
recommendation_template.body: No model monitoring approach is defined. Define latency, cost, quality, and drift monitoring before production deployment.
